prompt_html: True or false: The maximum profit on a short put position is equal to the value of the premium paid.

An investor receives a $1.00 premium for a put option with a $60.00 strike price when the underlying price was trading at $65.00. At expiration the stock has decreased to $59.00. What is the profit or loss on the option at expiration?

An investor receives a $2.00 premium for a put option with a $30.00 strike price when the underlying price was trading at $32.50. At expiration the stock has decreased to $25.00. What is the profit or loss on the option at expiration?
What is the profit on a short put at expiration which ends $10.00 out of the money for which the investor received a premium of $5.00.
